about_snippet.label: About Me
about_snippet.heading: Who I Am
about_snippet.paragraph_1: I'm a Computer Science student at Universitas Brawijaya with a passion for building full-stack web applications. I specialize in the MERN stack and Next.js, and I'm actively expanding into machine learning.
about_snippet.paragraph_2: I love turning complex problems into clean, user-friendly solutions — whether that's a scalable REST API, a responsive UI, or a predictive ML model.

bio.label: Introduction
bio.heading: About Me
bio.paragraph_1: I'm Ahmad Reza Adrian, a Computer Science student at Universitas Brawijaya, Malang. I'm passionate about building impactful digital products — from scalable web platforms to machine learning integrations.
bio.paragraph_2: My primary stack is the MERN stack combined with Next.js and TypeScript, but I'm always eager to explore new technologies. I believe clean code and good architecture are as important as working features.
bio.paragraph_3: Outside of coding, I enjoy problem-solving challenges on platforms like Codewars, contributing to open-source projects, and continuously learning through hands-on projects.
